name: MetaBalls-TS-TW
title: Liquid Metaballs
description: Soft white and purple liquid blobs float on black, joining into larger shapes when close and splitting apart as they drift, with one blob following the pointer.
use: A hero or product page wants an organic living backdrop that never repeats.
avoid: It is a full-screen shader running every frame, and it offers text no quiet area to sit on.
a11y: A decorative shader with nothing to operate; it loops constantly and ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black field holding a dozen rounded white blobs of different sizes and one violet blob, all with smooth melted edges. Neighbouring blobs stretch and fuse into peanut shapes.
behaves: Each blob follows its own slow orbit, so the group constantly merges and separates. The violet blob trails the pointer while it is over the panel and otherwise circles near the centre.
customise: Blob colour, cursor blob colour and size, count, animation size, speed, clump factor, hover smoothing, mouse interaction and transparency are props. There is no content.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader evaluates up to fifty metaballs for every pixel each frame.
